title: Magistrates Order Declaring Party Entitled To Retain Possession Of Land Etc. In Dispute
description: A magistrates order declaring party entitled to retain possession of land etc. in dispute used for criminal complaints, bail applications, or petitions in criminal proceedings. Suitable for accused persons, complainants, or their legal representatives in criminal matters. Key details required: Date (First Party), Date (Second Party), Date (Third Party), Signatory Name, Place/City (First Party).
description_hi: Magistrates Order Declaring Party Entitled To Retain Possession Of Land Etc. In Dispute — आपराधिक शिकायतें, जमानत आवेदन, या आपराधिक कार्यवाही में याचिकाएं के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। आपराधिक मामलों में अभियुक्त, शिकायतकर्ता, या उनके कानूनी प्रतिनिधि के लिए उपयुक्त। 6 आवश्यक विवरण भरने होंगे।
